meta.method: GeoNames populated places, US+CA, population >= 100,000; district/section entries removed via feature codes plus a reviewed blocklist (NYC boroughs and neighborhoods, Phoenix urban villages, LA districts, Canadian pre-amalgamation boroughs). New York City appears once. CDPs (e.g. Arlington VA, East Los Angeles CA, Urban Honolulu HI) are retained: they are real service markets.
meta.caveats: Populations are GeoNames-current (mixed 2020-2023 vintages). Cities hovering at 90-105k may be missing or borderline vs official 2023/2021 counts - P0 should hand-check the borderline band and add Strathcona County AB, Clarington ON, Pickering ON if targeting Canada broadly. Mexico excluded per spec scope (US+CA).
